info.name: Mission Health - local teammate handoff
info.description: Import this collection for manual testing against the local preview only. No requests are sent by importing it. Read CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/API.md first: npm ci; create ignored .dev.vars only if absent; npm run build; apply local D1 migrations; npm run dev. Default baseUrl is http://localhost:8765, without a trailing slash. The local Wrangler configuration uses LOCAL_PREVIEW=1. This collection rejects non-loopback targets. Production is protected by the authenticated Sites browser session; there is no invented anonymous API key or bearer-token login. Never add a caller-supplied identity header. Keep Azure and utility credentials in server-side runtime settings, outside this collection and Git. With AIR_GAP=1, no model request is allowed: saved records and deterministic rules can still be tested, but replies may be null with replyError and health agentAvailable may be false. Use synthetic text and test recordings only. File controls are intentionally empty and require manual selection of non-personal test material. Sending writes changes only the selected local database. IDs and capture times are generated once and saved for unchanged retries. To create a different case, clear that request's ID variable; its associated timestamp/date will be replaced. Do not modify a payload or selected file while reusing its ID: expect 409 conflicts for changed saved content. No example responses are fabricated in this collection.

request.description: This example uses source demo and no sensor timestamps; it is not a measurement of the current user. The server calculates its prototype severity floor. New completed processing returns HTTP 201 even if only rules are available; inspect result.agentAvailable, result.status and rules. HTTP 202 with pending true means another request holds the lease, not a completed AI analysis. GET reads do not call a model. Retry this POST unchanged with the saved ID and capturedAt. A changed snapshot under that ID returns HTTP 409 id_conflict. Clearing healthAnalysisId generates a new ID and current capture time.

request.description: Choose a non-personal test file manually. The empty file control does not expose or select files on your computer. room private scopes this upload to the local owner. HTTP 201 returns file metadata; copy the returned file.id into a deliberate chat request only if needed. The upload itself does not send the file to NasaGPT or publish it to the shared channel. Do not set a multipart Content-Type header manually.

request.description: Manually select a supported non-personal audio recording approximately five seconds long and keep duration accurate for the selected file. The file must contain supported media bytes and be between 44 bytes and 16 MiB. No file is preselected. The transcript is synthetic test text, not a recognized personal observation. Successful analysis returns HTTP 200; an unchanged completed retry returns HTTP 200 with duplicate true. An unavailable analysis may return HTTP 503 with status pending and saved true: this means the recording was saved, not that AI analysis succeeded. Changed bytes or recording kind under the same recordingId return HTTP 409. Preserve recordingId, recordingCreatedAt, metadata and bytes for unchanged retries; clear recordingId before choosing another file. With AIR_GAP=1 do not expect a cloud model result. Do not set a multipart Content-Type header manually.

formdata.value: Synthetic integration check. This recording is test material, not personal health data.
